selected_rows.reason: Highest current maintainer-leaderboard score, but upstream runtime currently relies on custom model code and a heavier/less portable stack; not used as the Windows default until its pinned local path is security/integration tested.
Very strong compact standard-Transformers model; attractive future independent parser after local Windows integration tests.
Top-tier benchmark performance plus mature PaddleOCR pipeline, local model caching, and practical portable integration.
Independent model family used as an optional verifier when self-hosted locally.

selection_policy: VeriCorpus does not equate leaderboard rank with release suitability. Default tools must also satisfy local execution, license clarity, reproducibility, security, maintainability, and Windows portability.
